toast.no_space: No free space - close or shrink a widget
toast.overlap: No free space, so it was placed overlapping
toast.save_failed: Couldn't save - check disk space or folder permissions
toast.reflowed: The screen size changed, so some widgets were moved

wc.title: Welcome to WidgetBoard
wc.body: Pick a layout to start with. You can add widgets later from the tray menu.
lay.partial: The screen is too small for some widgets; they were left out
toast.hidden: Hid {name}. To show it again, right-click it in Edit layout and choose Show
layers.title: Layers
layers.hint: Top is front. Drag a row to change the order. Ctrl+] / Ctrl+[ moves the selected widget one layer, with Shift to the front or back.
layers.locked: This widget's position is locked. Unlock it in Layers.
tut.title: Tutorial
tut.t1.tray: WidgetBoard lives in the taskbar. Right-click its icon.
tut.t1.grid: Widgets snap to this grid. Faded widgets are hidden and keep their spot.
tut.t1.move: Drag a widget by its top strip.
tut.t1.resize: Drag the bottom-right corner to resize.
tut.t1.push: Drop a widget onto another. The others make room.
tut.t1.menu: Right-click a widget. Each one has its own options.
tut.t1.add: Right-click an empty spot to add a widget there. The tray’s Add widget works too.
tut.t1.done: Press Done or Esc. Widgets work as usual again.
tut.t1.end: That’s the basics. The Tutorial and Guide tabs in Settings have the rest.
tut.welcome: Try a short practice tour before choosing your board.
